meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 写代码审查意见会变成一行一条:位置、问题、修法,可带 🔴bug、🟡risk、🔵nit、❓q 前缀,产出可直接粘进 PR 的评论文本。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-review,或说「review this PR」「review the diff」等指令时触发;安全类、架构分歧、新手引导场景不会用这种简短写法。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审一下这段 diff
say.note: 每条发现压成一行:位置、问题、修法

say.text: 对 auth.ts 做 caveman-review,只标 bug
say.note: 其余发现会归为 risk、nit 或 q

say.text: 停止 caveman-review,恢复正常风格
say.note: 回到原来的详细审查写法

howto.what_en: After install, Claude writes code review comments as one terse line per finding: location, problem, fix. Optional prefixes 🔴bug, 🟡risk, 🔵nit, ❓q. Output is ready to paste into a PR.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-review, or when you say "review this PR" or "review the diff". Security findings, architecture disputes and onboarding skip terse mode.

say_en.note: One line per finding: location, problem, fix.
Other findings become risk, nit or q.
